project_info.name: Read-Only Multi-Channel Ad Intelligence & Deep-Agent Diagnostic Platform
project_info.stack: React (JavaScript) + Tailwind CSS + Radix UI Primitives + Lucide Icons + Recharts
project_info.theme: Single Light Theme - Minimalist High-Contrast Editorial Analytics

design_philosophy.surfaces: Flat, sharp surfaces. ZERO gradients, ZERO neon glows, ZERO glassmorphism
design_philosophy.typography_rule: JetBrains Mono / font-mono for all tabular data, metrics, sparkline tooltips, and log traces. Clean Sans (Inter/System) for section headings and labels
design_philosophy.spacing: Generous and disciplined editorial density. Grid gap-4 to gap-6, card padding p-4 to p-6

layout_grid.header_bar: h-14 border-b border-slate-300 bg-white px-6 flex items-center justify-between sticky top-0 z-40
layout_grid.sub_header_controls: border-b border-slate-300 bg-slate-50 px-6 py-2.5 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3
layout_grid.pulse_kpi_strip: grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-5 gap-4 px-6 py-4 border-b border-slate-300 bg-white
layout_grid.main_dashboard_layout: p-6 grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 bg-[#fcfcfc]

account_switcher.description: Combobox selecting Platform (Meta, Google, TikTok, LinkedIn, All), Account ID, and Currency (USD, EUR, GBP, JPY). Must trigger instant data slice update across dashboard.

connector_drawer.description: OAuth & Sandbox Connector Drawer displaying Meta Ads, Google Ads, TikTok Ads, LinkedIn Ads. Shows original platform SVG icons/badges, token validity countdown, sandbox mock toggle, and 'Re-Authenticate' action.

items: Drilldown: Platform -> Campaign -> Ad Set -> Creative
Date Comparison: vs Previous Period, vs 30d Rolling Benchmark

pulse_kpi_strip.features: Monospace numbers, inline micro sparklines, delta percentage pills (+/-), cross-channel pacing text summary block

where_it_goes_wrong_root_causes.title: Where It Goes Wrong (Verified Root Causes)
where_it_goes_wrong_root_causes.structure: Cards with severity indicator (Ruby/Amber), dollar bleed impact, anomaly confidence rating, and expandable Radix Accordion for Deep-Agent Evidence Chains (Ad Fatigue, Audience Saturation, Attribution Overlap, Bid Inefficiency).

what_optimizations_to_take.title: What Optimizations To Take (Prescriptions & Simulator)
what_optimizations_to_take.structure: Prescription list sorted by dollar impact + Radix Slider budget-shift simulator. Moving the budget slider dynamically calculates and previews simulated blended ROAS & projected revenue gain.

live_agent_trace_ui.title: Live Deep-Agent Trace & Diagnostic Workspace
live_agent_trace_ui.structure: Split panel or Radix Tabs workspace with sub-agent nodes (Ingestion, Anomaly & Bleed Detector, Attribution & Cannibalization, Adversarial Critic), streaming planner TODO list, live tool call timeline, scratchpad files viewer, and final diagnostic verdicts.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a fully interactive, production-grade Read-Only Ad Intelligence Diagnostic Dashboard in React (JavaScript).
Strictly follow the light high-contrast editorial theme: flat white/slate background, 1px solid hairline borders, font-mono for numbers.
Do NOT use gradients, glassmorphism, or heavy shadows.

Implement real working state across all controls: Account Switcher, Attribution Window toggle, Drilldown selector, Date comparison, Budget Slider simulator, Connector Drawer toggle, and Agent Trace filters.
Add 'data-testid' to every interactive button, tab, card, slider, input, popover trigger, and key metric for robust end-to-end testing.
Ensure responsive behavior: stack cleanly on mobile/tablet viewports without horizontal text clipping.
